plans.title: Soy Nail Polish Remover With Jojoba Seed & Tea Tree Oil

before.description: 786 Cosmetics presents a new soy polish remover with new ingredients! Our 4 oz Soy-Based Nail Polish Remover is designed to gently remove nail polish. Jojoba Seed Oil replenishes the health and moisturization of your nails that was lost due to acetone-based nail polish removers. Tea Tree Oil helps to counter cracked and damaged cuticles. This product does not contain acetone or harsh acetates which will damage your nails, cuticles, and dry out your skin. 4 fl. oz / 118 mL -- Directions for use: Saturate a cotton ball or cotton pad with the Soy-Based Nail Polish Remover. Wipe all nails and allow the remover to absorb into the nail for at least 20-30 seconds. Wipe each nail until the polish is fully removed. Wash hands and nails thoroughly and dry well. Make sure the nail bed is dry and clean before applying new nail polish.
